clearances.touching_by_design_note: mounts/pads/saddles/ports/bonded foam (listed in verify.py allowed_contact); everything else must be >= 3 mm

foam.holder: PET film 0.3 mm bonded over every foam inner face; duct partitions/inner walls and the roof/M12 sleeves are printed so no cut foam edge faces the cabin

tubes.rule: od4 >= 15, od6 >= 20, od8 >= 25 mm; all internal tubes are 8 mm; only the exhaust line to the HEPA bends (r = 25)

amr_slots.size_mm: M6 slot 10.6 long x 6.6 wide, adjustable +-2 mm along x

orientation.base_plate: flat, legs pointing up (standing legs, 12 x 10 mm)
orientation.housing: roof down, open side up (no support except the vent slots/bosses are bridged by design)

print_fit.aluminium_needed: none: all four parts print in PETG; the deck legs (12 x 10 x 137 mm) can be swapped for 12 mm aluminium square tube if they wobble

thermal.conclusion: FAN NEEDED: without a fan the cabin air would settle about 26 K above ambient (ASSUMED duty 8 s per 30 s, 48 W) and the pump limit is +40 C ambient; with one 24 V 40 x 10 mm fan pulling 3 m3/h through the two baffled ducts the rise stays about 9 K (34 C at 25 C ambient); a continuous 48 W run would still reach about 32 K, so the pump must stay duty-limited.
thermal.fan_choice: quiet 24 V 40 x 40 x 10 mm fan, >= 7 m3/h free air at <= 22 dB(A) (model to choose); mounted on the -y duct opening, powered with the pump (or from a thermostat); blows INTO the cabin, exhaust duct on the +y wall at the top
thermal.caveat: single-node model, all electrical power treated as heat, no pump internal temperature rise above the cabin air (typically +5..10 K at the head): measure in the bench test

line_of_sight.blockers: housing (with ducts and slots), door, base plate (z <= 6.2 only, with slots/holes), bulkhead/M12/exhaust fittings, M6 washers; foam, film, deck, fan treated as transparent (conservative)
